title: content/boot/boot.json
description: M7-03 — the loc keys the boot screen (S01) renders. 13 §1's screen inventory is S01's whole specification and authors no strings; what is fixed here is that the screen shows a title, one status line per boot stage, and one failure line, and that every one of them is a key rather than a literal (X-04). Every value is a loc key, so ContentInvariants.CheckLocaleKeyReferences resolves it against every locale file: a key this document names but a locale does not carry fails the build, and a locale string this document stops naming fails it as an orphan. Deliberately narrow: a maintenance dialog, a forced-update prompt, a retry ladder and a first-run beat are M18-01's and M9's, and a schema that made room for them here would invite authoring them.

locKey.description: loc.<domain>.<id>.<field>, lowercase, dot-separated, snake_case segments — the same shape schema/loc.schema.json governs the locale files by.

title.description: The application title the splash draws. project.godot's application/config/name is the window title and is not localisable; this is the one a player reads.

stageStatus.description: One line per boot stage the player can be waiting in. The member set is closed and required in full: a stage with no line renders blank, and a blank line during a slow start is indistinguishable from a hung game.

failureStatus.description: The one line shown when boot does not complete. One line, not one per cause: the CAUSE is carried in code as a named failure kind and stage so it can be logged and told apart, while what a player is shown stays a single honest sentence until M18-01 authors the screen that says more.
